description.value:
Frequency once per hour

A minor, personal-scale omen — a candle that doesn't gutter when it should.

Produce a small, unmistakable omen at a point you can see within 30 feet: a flame that will not go out, water that stays still, a shadow that falls wrong, a sound only one named person hears. It is real, it is obviously not natural, and it lasts up to 10 minutes. It does no damage and moves nothing heavier than a candle, but everyone who sees it knows something is present.
